decisions.decision: Keep the mythic world and gods as real agents under M1 modernization.
Keep Books 1–4 as Telemachus' activation before Odysseus' physical release.
Retain Books 9–12 as an explicitly framed retrospective told at the Phaeacian court.
Compress ritual repetition, catalog, transit, and duplicated hospitality without changing responsibility.
Split the Cyclops story across two episodes so cleverness and pride carry separate consequences.
Place Aeolus and the Laestrygonians in one escalating episode about trust and catastrophic command loss.
Keep the Underworld, Sirens, Scylla, and Helios cattle as distinct moral tests.
Make Penelope's strategic agency continuous through gifts, dream, bow contest, and bed test.
Treat unnamed suitors as a chorus while preserving Antinous, Eurymachus, and Amphinomus.
Use concise contemporary Chinese dialogue while preserving status, ritual, and mythic setting.
Stage the hall violence as consequence-driven judgment, not consequence-free spectacle.
End with Laertes, civic feud, and divinely imposed peace rather than the bed recognition alone.
